hooks.command: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; root=$(realpath "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "validate-plugin hook skipped: jq is not installed" >&2; exit 0; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; f=$(realpath "$f" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in "$root"/.git/*) exit 0 ;; "$root"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$root/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && out=$(claude plugin validate . 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
